# Contract check: the immediate-return remember

**Date:** 2026-04-06
**Participants:** Wynn Castellano (Staff Engineer)

Wynn: "We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."

Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

positions.name: AsyncJobContractRatifiedAsSettled
positions.frame: Is the async job contract's shape (receipt-then-poll, no-blocking/no-loss guarantee, dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback) being reported as a concluded, ratified decision rather than a design still under argument?
positions.why: All three expressions come from the same speaker describing the same contract in a single breath: src-1 performs the ratification and states the receipt/cursor mechanic, src-2 states the guarantees as flat settled facts (no hedging), and src-3 explicitly labels the dispatch pattern a 'Key decision.' The conviction reading marks all three as 'decision' register — stated as concluded, not advanced as a position being argued for — which is what makes them cohere as one directional group rather than three independent facts. The tension the frame holds: src-2's conditional ('if the client drops the receipt') is the one hypothetical note inside an otherwise fully realis, settled description — held here as part of the same ratified-settledness read rather than resolved away.

placements.why: The envelope's content is a ratified design contract for how the remember pipeline dispatches and reports async work — receipt issuance, cursor polling, no-blocking/no-loss guarantees, and the poll-or-piggyback retrieval pattern. This is structural/mechanical system-design content with no existing strata category to hold it, and it is exactly the kind of organizational category (system architecture) the org's strata taxonomy is meant to carry going forward.

placements.title: remember as async dispatch: receipt, poll, no loss
placements.frame: As the async job contract for remember evolves, what guarantees (no blocking, no lost work) and retrieval paths (poll vs. piggyback) does each new envelope confirm, extend, or revise?
placements.why: All three segments describe facets of a single design subject — remember dispatches and returns an immediate receipt (src-1), the contract guarantees no blocking call and no lost work even if the client drops the receipt (src-2), and the agent retrieves the result by polling the run or getting it piggybacked on a later call (src-3). This is a design-pattern subject future envelopes about the job pipeline will keep feeding (refinements, edge cases, exceptions to the guarantees) rather than a one-time fact or measurement, so it clears the narrative grain test. No existing leaf or strata category was supplied to hold this system-design theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly minted Architecture strata.
